user_reported_bug: Loop 4473f240 was reported stuck by the founder on 2026-07-27: ChatPanel showed 'Loop failed to start' at the top of the chat while LoopStatusChip in the header simultaneously showed 'LOOP · PLANNING'. Root cause: /loop/start was synchronous — `async for _ev in engine.start(): pass` at loop.py:162 drained the entire plan phase before returning the HTTP response. Any complex plan taking >60s hit the frontend axios timeout (frontend/src/lib/api.js:15 has `timeout: 60000`). Backend session was created (lock write happens BEFORE the plan work), engine kept running, chip polled /loop/active and saw truth — but ChatPanel rendered the failure card from the raw axios error, so chip + chat contradicted.
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused Iter 312 verification found backend /loop/start now returns quickly and immediate second start 409s, but the end-to-end founder criteria are not met: /loop/active does not expose planning sessions, timeout recovery did not render the required still-working banner in browser simulation, and the ChatPanel recovery path does not open/bind SSE or process plan-ready events, so the approval card cannot reliably render after recovery.

critical.issue: Planning sessions are excluded from the active query (state $in omits 'planning'). BACKEND-3 failed: after POST /loop/start returned 200 in 0.107654s with {loop_id:'loop_487276bec65b46', state:'planning', phase:'plan', plan:null, async_start:true}, immediate GET /loop/active?project_id=p_norepotest returned {ok:true, active:null}. This breaks the frontend timeout recovery poll while a complex plan is still running.

Preview repo setup prevents a real simple/fast loop E2E: selected demo repos either have no PAT or an invalid PAT. Real UI submit returned HTTP 400 {'detail':'No PAT configured for this project...'}; p_norepotest background session immediately failed with 'GitHub PAT preflight failed: pat_invalid_or_expired'. Per verdict rules, missing required working preview data prevents declaring fixed.

minor.issue: BACKEND-1 and BACKEND-2 partial pass on p_norepotest: first POST returned 200 in 0.107654s with async_start:true; second immediate POST returned 409 loop_already_running with existing_loop_id matching the first loop. Rollback flag path was not runtime-tested after critical failures were found.

ui_bugs.issue: Timeout recovery browser simulation (real 60s axios timeout by holding /loop/start for 70s while /loop/active returned an active planning loop) did not render 'Plan taking longer than expected — still working…'. At 65s: still-working=false, loop-failed=false, plan-card=false, while LoopStatusChip displayed 'LOOP · PLANNING'. This does not satisfy founder criterion #1.
Plan approval card did not render after simulated recovery; no /loop/{loop_id}/stream request was observed. This directly fails founder criterion #2.

integration_issues.flow: Timeout recovery: startLoop axios timeout -> getActiveLoop -> SSE -> approval card
integration_issues.issue: Code review confirms the recovery branch only calls setLoopId/setLoopPhase and replaces the pending message. It does not call openLoopStream(active.loop_id), and there is no useEffect that opens SSE on loopId. handleLoopEvent also does not setLoopPlan from ev.data.plan, while showPlanCard requires loopPhase === 'plan_pending'. Therefore even if active polling succeeds, the plan-ready SSE cannot update the chat into an approval card.

Could not verify a normal fast loop E2E in preview because available projects have missing/invalid PATs. The actual UI flow with the selected demo project returned a red HTTP 400 PAT error instead of a plan; no approval card appeared.

action_items: Add 'planning' to /loop/active's active-state query so timeout recovery and LoopStatusChip can see an in-progress plan immediately after async start.
In ChatPanel timeout recovery, actually open/bind the loop SSE stream after setLoopId(active.loop_id).
Handle plan-ready/awaiting_confirmation SSE events by setting loopPlan from ev.data.plan and replacing the recovery/pending bubble with formatted plan markdown.
Relax/fix showPlanCard gating so recovered plan states such as 'awaiting_confirmation' or phase 'plan' can render the approval card; do not require only 'plan_pending'.
Provide a valid preview project/PAT or a safe no-ship fixture so the founder's simple fast-task regression can be verified end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/loop.py:get_active_loop state filter includes awaiting_confirmation/executing/verifying/scanning/shipping/paused_for_user/self_healing but not planning, so active polling during the long plan phase returns null.
frontend/src/components/ChatPanel.jsx recovery block comments say 'Bind SSE', but the code never calls openLoopStream(active.loop_id).
ChatPanel handleLoopEvent does not read ev.data.plan or call setLoopPlan when state='awaiting_confirmation', phase='plan'.
showPlanCard requires loopPhase === 'plan_pending', but recovery sets loopPhase to active.phase/state (usually 'plan' or 'awaiting_confirmation'), preventing recovered approvals.

rca_of_the_issue: The backend async fire-and-forget part is only partially fixed. The reconciliation chain still has gaps: /loop/active hides planning sessions; ChatPanel timeout recovery only mutates local state/message and does not attach SSE; plan-ready SSE data is not consumed into loopPlan; approval-card gating is incompatible with recovered states. Result: the founder-visible contradiction class is still possible, and the required recovery-to-plan outcome is not implemented end to end.
